# function: issuer_config

Builds the IssuerConfig message from an object and returns its protojson encoding, the value `authwise_issuer.config` takes: the same string `data.authwise_issuer_config` exposes as `json` for the same arguments, with the same attributes and checks. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

Use it in place of the data source to keep plans quiet. Terraform reads a data source at apply whenever a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, so `authwise_issuer.config` plans an update that applies as a no-op; this function is evaluated at plan whenever its argument is known.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every login goes to one realm. Evaluated at plan, so a change to the
# realm does not plan an issuer update.
resource "authwise_issuer" "this" {
  domain_id = authwise_domain.this.domain_id
  config = provider::authwise::issuer_config({
    access_token_expire_seconds = 900

    single_realm_provider_selector = {
      realm_name = authwise_realm.employees.name
    }

    cors = {
      allowed_origins = ["https://app.example.com"]
    }
  })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
issuer_config(config dynamic) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Dynamic) An object with the attributes of `data.authwise_issuer_config`, snake_case as there. Unset attributes are left out.
